Pawan Kumar, Advocate) This Writ Petition Is Filed Under Articles 226 And 227 Of The Constitution Of India Praying To Quash The Closure Notice Dtd. 10.09.2024 Bearing No. Sn(Pp)/Rrnv/25/2024-25 Issued By The R-3 (Annx-A); Direct The R-2 And 3 To Consider The Representation Letter Submitted Dtd. 12.09.2024 And Grant License To The Petitioners To Run The Business Of Live Chicken Slaughtering And Cold Storage In Accordance With Law (Annx-F). This Petition, Coming On For Preliminary Hearing, This Day, Order
texts.facts: The petitioners filed this writ petition seeking for quashing the impugned notice dated 10.09.2024 issued by respondent No.3 vide Annexure-A, etc. 2. The brief facts leading rise to the filing of this Writ Petition are as follows: The petitioner No.1 is the sister of petitioner No.2. Both the petitioners are carrying on business of chicken slaughter unit and cold storage of dressed chicken under NC: 2024:KHC:40947 the name & style of M/s. TDL Feed and Farms. The petitioners submits that they have obtained Food License dated 23.08.2024, under FSS Act, 2006, vide License No.11224332000934 from the Government of Karnataka, Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), valid from 23.08.2024 to 22.08.2025, and the same was issued by the Designated Officer, Food Safety and Standard Department, BBMP Area West Zone, Bengaluru. The petitioners submitted a representation dated 28.08.2024, to the respondent No.3 seeking permission and required license from the BBMP, Bengaluru for running the business. The petitioners have submitted another request letter to the Commissioner, BBMP on 12.09.2024. Both are pending consideration. The respondent No.3 without having powers conferred under the Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike Act, 2020, issued a notice to close down the industry and the Smt Puttamma vs The Commissioner on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95905949/ 2 notice issued by respondent No.3 is without jurisdiction. The respondents without passing any final orders, are pressurizing the NC: 2024:KHC:40947 petitioners to close down the industry. Hence, this Writ Petition. The respondent No.3 without considering the representations submitted by the petitioners, is insisting the petitioners to close down the industry. Hence, action of respondent No.3 in insisting the petitioners to close down the industry is arbitrary, illegal and unreasonable. Hence, on these grounds, he prays to allow the Writ Petition. The respondent No.3 has issued notice to the petitioners as per Annexure-A for closure of the industry. The petitioners have submitted representations as per Annexures 'E' and 'F' for issuance of necessary license. The respondent No.3 without considering the representations, is insisting the petitioners to close down the industry.
